user.title: Connect to your GoodWe ETA inverter
user.description: Connect GW EnergyPilot directly to the GoodWe ETA inverter over Modbus TCP. Before continuing, make sure the inverter uses a static IP address or DHCP reservation so its address cannot change.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address of the GoodWe ETA inverter. Configure a static IP address or DHCP reservation in your router.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port. The normal GoodWe ETA value is 502.
data_description.slave: Modbus Unit ID. The commonly used GoodWe ETA value is 247.

controller.title: Configure EMHASS control
controller.description: Automatic battery control requires a working EMHASS environment. First make sure EMHASS can complete an optimization and publish its results to Home Assistant. EV coordination is optional and can be configured later.

data_description.p_batt_entity: Select the published EMHASS battery power target, normally sensor.p_batt_forecast. The state must be numeric and expressed in watts.
data_description.optim_status_entity: Optional EMHASS optimization status entity, normally sensor.optim_status.
data_description.optim_required_state: EnergyPilot only follows EMHASS when the optimization status matches this value. Recommended: Optimal.
data_description.max_power: Maximum charge or discharge power EnergyPilot may request from the inverter. Example: 15000 W equals 15 kW.
data_description.deadband: Targets inside this range around 0 W are treated as Battery Hold to prevent unnecessary switching. Recommended: 300 W. A typical range is 200-500 W.
data_description.scan_interval: How often EnergyPilot refreshes GoodWe ETA telemetry. Recommended: 10 seconds.
data_description.enable_ev_coordination: Optional. When enabled, EnergyPilot can react to an EV charging state or charging power entity.
data_description.ev_power_entity: Optional EV charging-power entity in watts.
data_description.ev_deadband: Charging power above this value is considered active EV charging.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the GoodWe ETA inverter or read EMS registers 47511/47512. Verify the inverter IP address, port, Unit ID and Modbus TCP availability.

abort.already_configured: This GoodWe ETA inverter is already configured.

init.title: GW EnergyPilot options
init.description: Configure automatic control only after EMHASS is working and its published entities contain valid values.

data_description.optim_status_entity: Optional EMHASS optimization status entity, normally sensor.optim_status.
